subject: POC kickoff + hands-on working session — capacity split (Dedicated vs Hosted)
body:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan@stately.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintra.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff and capacity discussion

Hi Maya / Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Stately is ready to move to a hands-on POC — we want to run through a short kickoff to align scope, then a longer working session to validate routing and run a small load test. Two quick asks from our side:

- Can you help us decide whether we should start the POC on Hosted (fast) vs Dedicated (predictable) for the first 2 weeks?
- We expect bursts of ~350 QPS and avg seq length ~512 tokens on the most frequent endpoint — can you confirm token budget and potential rate-limit bumps for that profile?

Available windows next week (PST): Mon 6/21 10–12, Tue 6/22 14–16, Wed 6/23 09–11.

Jordan
Lead ML Engineer | Stately AI

----
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@stately.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and capacity discussion

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run two separate gatherings so we can keep the kickoff tight and the hands-on unblocked:

1) POC kickoff (30 min) — agenda: objectives, success metrics, short checklist (auth, data flows, models to test).
2) Hands-on working session (90–120 min) — prompt review, routing config, KV/prefix caching, small load test plan.

Proposal (PST):
- Kickoff: Mon 6/21 10:30–11:00
- Hands-on: Tue 6/22 14:00–16:00 (we can extend to 17:00 if needed)

Attached: POC-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + roles) and token-estimates.csv (rough cost by model/seq length). Please review the token sheet before the hands-on — it has the sample traffic mix we used for cost projections.

Quick notes on your Qs: starting on Hosted is usually fastest (no provisioning), but Dedicated can be pre-warmed for stable latency if you expect sustained high QPS. For a first 2-week spike I usually recommend Hosted for speed and then switch to Dedicated for sustained loads — we can sketch the transition plan during the kickoff.

If those times work I’ll send calendar invites and assign pre-work (model list + top 10 prompts).

Attachments:
- [Attachment: POC-agenda-v2.pdf (5 pages)]
- [Attachment: token-estimates.csv (calc sheet)]

Best,
Maya Srinivasan\Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

----
From: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@stately.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and capacity discussion

Adding a few infra items for the hands-on/load test:

- If Jordan's team will hit ~350 QPS with bursts, we should request a temporary rate-limit quota bump on the hosted tier before the load test. I can submit the quota request; need expected sustained QPS and test duration.
- For load testing we recommend a canary schedule: 15m warmup at 30% QPS, 30m ramp to 70%, 15m peak. This helps us observe KV cache hit curves.
- HubSpot deal linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1042 — please add anticipated peak token/sec to the deal notes so support can process the quota change quickly.

Connor O'Brien\Technical Account Manager | Redwood Inference

----
From: Jordan Myers <jordan@stately.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and capacity discussion

Thanks — Mon/Tue windows look fine. Prefer kickoff Mon 10:30. For the hands-on we prefer Tue 14:00 but can do Wed morning if you recommend more prep time.

On Dedicated vs Hosted: our legal team wants Dedicated once we start ingesting customer PII (likely after week 1). Is there an expedited path to provision a small Dedicated pool just for the hands-on? If not, we'll start on Hosted and plan a quick migration.

I’ll circulate the list of models and example prompts by EOD today.

—Jordan

----
From: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@stately.ai>, maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and capacity discussion

Jordan — quick engineering note: provisioning Dedicated typically requires a 24–48 hour lead to pre-warm GPU pools and to apply tenant isolation controls. If you need Dedicated for the hands-on we can try to prioritize but we’ll need an explicit request (model sizes, expected RPS, retention/SLO needs).

Recommendation: start Hosted for days 0–3 to validate prompts and routing, run the load test there (with a quota bump), then cutover to Dedicated for any PII-sensitive traffic once the SOW/contract is signed. That minimizes disruption and gives your legal/infra teams time to approve Dedicated.

Also: please include expected model checkpoint size and the tokenization profile (avg/95p lengths). That helps us pick kernels and quantify KV memory in the Dedicated pool.

Dylan Brooks\Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

----
From: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan@stately.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and capacity discussion

Jordan — confirmed. I’ve sent calendar invites for both sessions (links below) and split the hands-on into two blocks so we can do routing/prompt review first, then the load test:

- Kickoff: Mon 6/21 10:30–11:00 PDT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=kickoff-6-21
- Hands-on part A (prompt review + routing): Tue 6/22 14:00–15:15 PDT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=hands-on-6-22-a
- Hands-on part B (load test & metrics): Tue 6/22 15:30–17:00 PDT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=hands-on-6-22-b

Action items assigned:
- Jordan / Stately: share model list + top 10 prompts by EOD Fri 6/18 (Jordan to upload to the shared doc).
- Connor: submit hosted quota bump request (I asked for 2x expected peak; see HubSpot deal comments).
- Dylan: estimate pre-warm time & memory for Dedicated if requested (include GPU config).
- Kimberly: prep SOW / expedited Dedicated provisioning checklist and send DocuSign link if Stately requests Dedicated.

Attachments referenced above were included in the initial email. I’ll also upload a short runbook to the shared doc for the load test. If you think we should provision a minimal Dedicated pool ASAP, flag in HubSpot and Kimberly will follow up with the SOW.

DocuSign (SOW template): https://docusign.com/rooms/sow-stately-temp
Shared agenda: https://docs.google.com/document/d/POC-Agenda
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1042

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Maya Srinivasan\Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
